text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what a cliffhanger to end on...
Next volume, next volume... Huh, where's volume 3?

Oh, Hishi Miracle-san.
Are you reading?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Fully enjoying autumn, the season of reading~.
Though honestly, it's all just manga.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Shojo manga, sports manga, battle manga...
You read so many different genres."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my friends lent all of these to me.
Do you want to read them too, Durandal-chan?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I will read it. This 4-panel manga—
its linear sequence of rectangles
speaks straight to my artistic sensibilities!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I shall take this fantasy manga.
It appears a knight makes an appearance...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Go right ahead~. Feel free to snack
on any of the treats on the table, okay?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, it's almost lunchtime.
If cup noodles are fine, I have enough for both of you too~

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Bringing lunch all the way here means you have zero intention of moving, huh.
Truly the pinnacle of laziness, Mirako-san. Down the hatch!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, there's a whole variety of flavors too.
So, how is it? Is that manga interesting?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Yes. Introduction, development, twist, and conclusion! The fast pace of 4-panel manga is the absolute best! Plus, the neat panel layout—straight lines reign supreme!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... It pains me greatly to say this.
However, I simply cannot accept the knight in this manga!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: *crunch, munch, munch* Whah kin' of, *crunch, crunch*, talk i' 'hi' *munch, crunch*?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
All that crunching is too loud!!
Either eat or talk, pick one!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's one of those "reincarnated as a villainess" stories, right?
Where you get reincarnated into a game's world as the villainess who's doomed to be condemned at the end—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: You're dragging this out! Durandal, sum it up in three lines.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I've reincarnated as a villainess doomed to ruin!
I'll become a virtuous lady and secure a peaceful future!
...Yet here I am, about to have my engagement broken by the prince over a false accusation!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
—And the knight serves that prince.
The prince made a mistake out of love for the heroine...
A knight should have admonished his lord...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Without even pursuing the truth, even the knight is
lost in infatuation with the heroine!
This knight is an absolute disgrace to knighthood!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, then you just need to turn it into a story you can accept.
Show me how the knight Durandal fights.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
! Indeed, let me show you
what true chivalry is all about!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I shall play the villainess!
Here I come, commoner heroine Mirako-san!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...No, that was just about a manga... Wait,
you're not even listening, are you? Yeah, thought so. Figured as much.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Miss Right O, rumors say that consumed by jealousy, you harassed Miss Hishi Miracle.
However, doubts remain as to the truth. First, let us speak—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
How absurd. I have no interest in the prince whatsoever.
The engagement is off! I wish you all the best!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Huh, it worked itself out?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what... That was blasphemy against my liege!
As a knight, I cannot let that slide!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It is no blasphemy, but fact. Tell your prince:
I'll consider it once he breaks 54 seconds on the Niigata 1,000m straight!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
What a wild turn of events... Ah, my cup noodles are ready.
Time to eat. Thanks for the food!
(Slurp, shhhhk, slurrrp...)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
! Instant noodles, making noodle sounds!?
It's not crunchy at all!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Ah, Daitaku-chan,
you ate it right after pouring in the hot water, didn't you?
No wonder it was crunchy~. The noodles were still dry.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...
Instant noodles... tasting like authentic ramen!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Mirako-san— I want to eat the instant ramen you make for the rest of my life.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I-Is that... a proposal!?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the friendship ending between the villainess and the heroine...
Did I... just cut off my liege's future...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... I'm sure the Prince is happy
that you protected his honor, Durandal-chan.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
See, even without me, the prince still has a fiercely loyal knight by his side.
Isn't that a happy ending~?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...For my Liege... I shall!
Indeed! In that case, I will dedicate my entire life to providing my master with cup noodles!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Mm, now this is a grand finale!
It turned out even more moving than a manga!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Still, that is truly impressive adaptability. Most people would just be utterly bewildered if they got swept up in Light O-san's pace.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
She even spoke up against the high-ranking villainess.
Chivalry is just so cool~!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
H-Hishi Miracle-san...!
Ugh... If I falter here, I'll be no better than the knight in the manga...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: That's the Femme Fatale Mirako ending for ya!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Still, that is truly impressive adaptability. Most people would just be utterly bewildered if they got swept up in Light O-san's pace.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"—No.
To begin with, the moment the villainess was Right O-san,
it was doomed to fall apart!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I am justice incarnate!
Of course acting as a villainess would be an impossible task for me!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Still, that is truly impressive adaptability. Most people would just be utterly bewildered if they got swept up in Light O-san's pace.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah... well, um... It's kind of an everyday occurrence... you know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's typical for Tracen Academy, and there are lots of unique girls around me too.
Maybe I'm just getting used to it~.
